claim_limits: Policies implemented in the DITSERVE framework are in-framework comparisons, not executions of TetriServe or GF-DiT official implementations.
README references to SD3 do not establish support or correctness for SD3.5 medium.
Wan2.1 and Wan2.2 are two versions within the Wan family; they do not demonstrate generalization across video-model families.
Two independent 8-GPU jobs are two replicas, not a single 16-GPU, cross-node distributed experiment.
Version constraints satisfied in the observed subset do not prove installation feasibility, API compatibility, runnable kernels, correctness or comparable performance.
The seven-package runtime snapshot predates the official Wan22 directory replacement; its model root/config readout is not a complete verified model manifest.
Published README performance numbers are not measurements in this environment and are never copied into local benchmark results.

execution_policy.environment_change: If required dependencies cannot coexist in the current image, obtain an explicitly user-approved new environment/image source. Local WSL and cluster image building remain prohibited. Do not silently downgrade packages or substitute policy implementations.
execution_policy.future_remote_guard: Before every authorized future write/transfer/submission check df -h /data; stop all project work above 790G used or at 80 percent. Re-check active long jobs. Job submission remains with the designated operator.

required_evidence: Full official repository and 40-character commit; source inventory hash, clean-tree status and any patch hash; exact launcher and benchmark-client source hashes.
Pin all submodules, gfc, vLLM/base framework and xDiT component revisions; distinguish upstream official code, compatibility patch and reimplementation.
Record actual command, resolved config hash, effective policy and collective backend; GF-DiT runtime_v2 must be enabled. A README link is not execution evidence.
User-approved environment/image source and immutable digest; full package inventory/lock, Python/CUDA/driver/NCCL versions and import locations.
Resolve audited TetriServe diffusers==0.33.0 vs 0.36.0 and numpy<2 vs 2.2.6; GF-DiT cache-dit==1.3.0 vs 1.5.0. Preserve incompatible environment comparisons as a documented limitation.
Run authorized import, kernel and official single-request smoke only after source/environment provenance is complete; a package version match alone is insufficient.
Freeze request manifest bytes/SHA256, ordered IDs, prompts/negative prompts, prompt-source identity and normalized-prompt split membership for every arm.
Exclude known exploration prompts and record split leakage checks; reuse the exact same prompt and inference seed per paired request across systems.
Hash adapter-transformed request payloads and prove they preserve all generation parameters and requested outputs; do not silently drop unsupported inputs.

prior_exposure.scope: Excludes all known local exploration and all source-pool dev prompts; unknown prior exposure is not ruled out

required_evidence: Freeze exact arrival/deadline trace bytes and canonical SHA256, load definition, offered rates, duration, request order and all formal matrix cells before observing results.
Use open-loop arrivals measured by one documented monotonic clock; record actual dispatch skew and backpressure, concurrency caps, batching and reject/timeout policy.
A serial/model-runner throughput loop is not a matched serving workload; unsupported mixed-model/mixed-resolution cases remain explicitly not applicable, with no substitution.

frozen_values.shape_distribution: uniform within modality, integer remainder assigned in shape_ids order

required_evidence: Freeze identical per-request absolute deadlines using the same per-shape SP1 end-to-end reference calibration and its measured source/GPU identity.
Record deadline start/finish boundaries including queue, text encoder, diffusion and decode. No system-specific re-scaling of SLOs after observing performance.
Report SAR separately for image/video and each formal shape; publish the complete planned denominator.

frozen_values.basis: per-shape measured SP1 end-to-end service, frozen across all policies

required_evidence: Pin exact model repositories/revisions and verified per-file size/SHA256 inventories, tokenizer/text-encoder/VAE/scheduler configuration, solver steps and guidance.
Use the verified official Wan22 component directory and bind its manifest; the historical runtime-facts model root is insufficient.
Demonstrate actual support for each exact model/shape, including text-to-video vs image-conditioned mode; README SD3, generic WAN or Wan2.2 A14B labels cannot fill missing evidence.
Run paired output/quality checks across systems; report acceptable numeric tolerances and separate serving-prompt quality from the complete pinned official VBench protocol.

quality.official_protocol: complete pinned dimension/prompt manifest; 5 seeds, temporal flickering 25; no replacement with VidProM

required_evidence: Freeze and record actual transformer/text-encoder/VAE dtypes, autocast/TF32/determinism flags, quantization and compilation for each component in every arm.
Force and attest the effective attention backend/kernel, version and fallback behavior; xDiT auto-selection must not make systems differ silently.
Exact-mode comparison disables approximate caching, skipped steps, sparsity and unsupported mixed-precision tricks; separately labelled quality-matched approximate arms require fresh evidence.
Record SP/CFG/TP/PP degrees and allowed rank sets; match output semantics and solver progression. Resolve any impossible matching constraint before measured comparisons.
Record allocated GPU UUIDs/model/memory, node IDs, interconnect/topology, CPU/RAM/thread/affinity caps, co-tenants, power/clocks and actual reservation duration.
Match device count and compute entitlement, not just number of launched processes. Charge residency and idle reservations as GPU-seconds.
Predeclare model-loading, compilation, profiling and per-shape warmup requests/seeds/counts; log completion and cost. Publish cold-start and warmed service boundaries separately.
Use interleaved/randomized arm order with matched seeds and resource conditions; profile and warmup data must not leak test prompts into tuning.
Publish every planned system/seed/shape/load cell and every planned request, including unstarted, rejected, timed-out, OOM, interrupted and failed requests.
Retain raw failure evidence and reason; never omit failed cells or encode unstarted counterfactuals as measured zero-throughput.
Measure E2E p50/p95/p99, per-modality/shape SLO attainment, goodput and reserved/active GPU-seconds with exact observation windows; drain/censor rules frozen before runs.
Report paired effects and confidence intervals over independent seeds/runs, not request-level pseudoreplication; publish all selected cells and quality qualifications.
Select at least one non-Wan video family supported by the compared systems (candidate only: HunyuanVideo or CogVideoX; exact variant not yet selected/approved).
Before downloading anything, freeze exact official model revision, licensing/access and disk/memory estimate, approved acquisition/environment source and representative quality/shape protocol.
Collect full correctness, exact-model compatibility, performance and failure evidence for the new family; two Wan versions alone remain within-family coverage.
Declare and qualify each hardware topology separately. Current A100 PCIe measurements cannot be relabelled as the H100/A40 evidence quoted in external READMEs.
For a 16-GPU claim require a single job/session, world_size=16, complete global rank-to-GPU UUID/node map, at least two node identities and the exact global launch command.
Measure actual cross-node collective/resharding traffic, network backend and communication time, plus matched 1/2/4/8/16-GPU sweeps with the same workload/model semantics.
Two separately scheduled 8-GPU jobs may provide independent repetitions only; queue capacity and two allocations do not demonstrate distributed scaling.
Independent review verifies external-code provenance, applicability, fair controls, complete raw evidence and stated claim scope before considering a P5 stage gate.
This preflight tool always emits allows=[] and p5_qualified=false, even when all observed declaration checks are compatible; it does not implement or grant that future gate.
